title: Measure what burns Genlock's CPU and replace the top polls with events

requirements.text: The Mac app, bridge and voice server are profiled over minutes with normal sessions open, and costs are ranked by function with numbers
requirements.check: file: scratchpad report with sample output and per-function percentages

requirements.text: For each top cost an event-driven replacement is proposed (hooks, FSEvents/DispatchSource, appended-bytes reads), naming which polls stay and why
Small obvious wins are fixed directly with before/after CPU numbers from the same measurement

text: Scope widened: make genlock as event driven as possible; timers only where nothing can notify (time expiry, usage server). Show ranked CPU + plan before big changes
user_said: one to make genlock as event driven as possible
